registered: 2026-10-07, before any scoring (Test Lead correction to a13e25db: undetermined must not equal clean)
extends: quiz-registry-v6.json; supersedes a13e25db's exclusion of UNRESOLVED Q3 picks

unresolved_treatment.regret: an UNRESOLVED pick takes its band-pessimistic value: the worst consistent with the reference band. A SELECTED_UNRESOLVED pick takes the false-acceptance cost, and an ABSTENTION_UNRESOLVED the missed-opportunity cost (the contract's mistake costs)
unresolved_treatment.false_feasible: UNRESOLVED stays in the denominator. Variant (i), the gate default: a SELECTED_UNRESOLVED pick counts as false-feasible (the model called it safe). Variant (ii): excluded from numerator and denominator (the a13e25db behaviour), reported for sensitivity
unresolved_treatment.over_caution: UNRESOLVED stays in the denominator and earns no credit; an ABSTENTION_UNRESOLVED counts as over-caution

known_bad: control-band_edge_seeker (constructed: wherever a reference lies within its contract band of a plating or thermal limit, it reports the case as just passing, so it steers picks into the band; accurate elsewhere)
